about_pullquote: A good garden is an investment in your home and your peace of mind.
about_para_1: EU Gardening Services has been transforming Manchester gardens for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that every outdoor space deserves care and attention, we've built our reputation through honest work, fair pricing, and genuine passion for horticulture. From modest residential plots to complex landscaping projects, we've earned the trust of hundreds of Manchester homeowners.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what you want your garden to become, not what we think it should be. We're based right here in Openshaw and know Manchester's climate, soil, and growing conditions inside out. Whether you need a quick spring tidy or a complete garden transformation, you'll get a straight answer and a fair quote every time.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete jungle of a back garden that hadn't been touched in three years. EU Gardening came out, gave us a free consultation, and completely redesigned it. They kept us updated throughout, cleaned up every day, and the result is brilliant. Kids actually want to play in it now. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Regular maintenance service monthly. Always arrive on time, do a thorough job, and tidy up properly. Way better than trying to DIY it myself. Fair pricing and never tried to upsell me on work I don't need. Will stick with them.
reviews.author: Susan W.

reviews.text: Needed an old apple tree removed and the stump gone. Quoted by two other firms at silly prices. EU Gardening came in 30% cheaper and actually explained exactly what they were doing. Job done in a day, site left spotless. Top blokes.
reviews.author: David P.
